scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -n CONTRACTS,FRONTEND,API -c blue,green,cyan "npm run dev:contracts" "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm run dev --workspace functions"
scripts.dev:platform: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -n CONTRACTS,FRONTEND,API,EDGE,MQTT -c blue,green,cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run dev:contracts" "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm run dev --workspace functions" "npm run dev --workspace @spff/edge-gateway" "npm run dev --workspace @spff/mqtt-worker"
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev --workspace frontend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev --workspace functions
scripts.dev:edge: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev --workspace @spff/edge-gateway
scripts.dev:mqtt-worker: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev --workspace @spff/mqtt-worker
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run build:edge && npm run build:mqtt-worker && npm run build:sync-worker
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @spff/contracts && npm run lint --workspace frontend && npm run lint --workspace functions && npm run lint --workspace @spff/edge-gateway && npm run lint --workspace @spff/mqtt-worker && npm run lint --workspace @spff/sync-worker
scripts.mqtt:logs: docker compose --env-file infrastructure/mqtt/.env -f infrastructure/mqtt/compose.yml logs -f mosquitto
scripts.firebase:emulators: npm run build && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.24.0 emulators:start
scripts.firebase:deploy: npm run build && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.24.0 deploy --only hosting,functions
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @spff/contracts && npm run test --workspace functions && npm run test --workspace @spff/edge-gateway && npm run test --workspace @spff/mqtt-worker
